interest: Shows the multi-agency clearance a businessman needed to visit occupied Japan in 1949.
overview: Isaac Flitterman's October 1949 application, for Surplus Corporation of America, to visit occupied Japan to supervise manufacturing contracts, with bank reference and State Department permit requirements.
